name: Transient-Aware Depth Prior
definition: Incorporating geometric priors from a monocular depth network (DPT) into NeRF training, adjusted for scale/shift and filtered by transient confidence.
summary: The Transient-Aware Depth Prior is a NeRF regularization technique that applies monocular depth supervision only to static regions by weighting the loss with transient confidence, preventing incorrect geometry learning for moving objects.
